tool.name: RFEM Thermal BC Generator
tool.description: Apply Dirichlet BCs to zmin/zmax faces of an RFEM mesh (nodof=1)
tool.help:
Applies Dirichlet boundary conditions to the upstream (zmax) and downstream (zmin) faces of a structured RFEM mesh.
For diffusion problems: val_upstream = C_upstream (from Sievert's law), val_downstream = 0 (or C_downstream).
For thermal problems: val_upstream = T_hot, val_downstream = T_cold.
Both faces are written to the .fix file (penalty method, nodof=1, sense=1). The .dat file is updated with the correct fixed_freedoms count and nr=0.
The .fix file is shared across all random field instances — only the material properties (diffusivity) change per instance, not the boundary conditions.
